headline: Kenya Tea Sector Reforms Lift Smallholder Green Leaf Rates to Sh30 per Kg
summary: Regulatory and operational reforms in Kenya's tea industry resulted in green leaf grower payments nearly doubling from Sh16 to Sh30 per kilogramme, alongside enhanced farmer credit access.
why: Tea is Kenya's second-largest source of foreign exchange; increasing farmer earnings supports rural consumer spending and economic liquidity.

impacts.name: Kenya Agriculture
impacts.why: Nearly doubling green leaf procurement payouts directly bolsters agricultural household income.
